title: Gift shopping on a shared PC? Press 3 keys 🎁 #Shorts
description:
Don't let your browser history spoil the surprise. Open a private window before you start shopping.

⌨️ Windows: Ctrl + Shift + N (Chrome, Edge) | Firefox: Ctrl + Shift + P
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Shift + N (Chrome, Safari, Edge) | Firefox: Cmd + Shift + P
📱 iPhone: Safari tabs view, then Private | Android: Chrome menu ⋮, then New Incognito tab

Close all private windows when you're done. Private browsing does not make you anonymous: websites, your internet provider, school or employer can still see activity, and downloads and bookmarks stay on the device.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
